exception_wrapper_hresult.basis: Both selected registration receipt rows record hresult=-2146232800. The historical guest script assigns $_.Exception.HResult; the hexadecimal value is its 32-bit representation, not a separately observed Win32 or deployment API error.

bounded_interpretation.payload_basis: The existing official-apps-inspection.json under uat/v1-assets/f08fc54e44cf43eb811bc317c4249158 records the Notepad x64 package's 232 files / 11850868 bytes, Notepad\Notepad.exe and Windows.FullTrustApplication manifest. This is not only the System32 stub and is not proof of successful registration or execution.
bounded_interpretation.path_basis: The historical input/v1-sandbox-guest.ps1 creates and extracts into guest-local C:\PaneBindV1\OfficialApps\<RunId>, rechecks extracted file hashes, and passes its full manifestPath to Add-AppxPackage. Only the source ZIP is read from the read-only Input mapping.
bounded_interpretation.scope_note: 本文件仅整理同一旧 RunId 的已有证据；保留原始失败与身份。Event 709 明确记录 package-root 拒绝，但现有记录未证明其更深层原因，也不能推出 Sandbox 永久不支持该应用。
